lines.en: label utadorm30:
I knock on Uta’s door, figuring that this might be a good time to ask her about what caused her to storm out of the love hotel the other day.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Uta 的门，心想这大概是问她那天为什么会冲出情人酒店的好时机。

lines.en: I also figure it’s a good time to return her underwear that I may or may not have used to pleasure myself multiple times.
lines.zh: 我还想，这也是把她那条内裤还回去的好时机——那条我也许用过、也许没用过好几次来自慰的内裤。

lines.en: And before you ask, yes. I washed them.
lines.zh: 在你开口问之前，先说清楚：是，我洗过了。

lines.en: To be perfectly honest, I thought about keeping them instead. But the idea of her wearing them {i}after{/i} what I did is simply too good for me to pass up.
lines.zh: 老实说，我本来想的是留下它们。可是一想到她会在我做过的那些事{i}之后{/i}再穿上它们，这个念头实在太妙了，我实在舍不得放弃。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: scene black
The question now is whether I want to just drop them on the floor of her room without drawing any attention to it, or leverage this position of power to embarrass her.
lines.zh: 现在的问题是，我是想悄悄把它们丢在她房间地板上、不引起任何注意，还是要利用这个有利位置来让她难堪。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties1
: Oh, Sensei! What’s up? I was actually just thinking about you.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！怎么啦？我刚才其实正在想你呢。

lines.en: : Was it about how you left your panties behind at the love hotel and how they’re currently stuffed into my pocket?
lines.zh: : 是在想你怎么把内裤落在情人酒店、而它们现在正被塞在我口袋里的事吗？

lines.en: I leverage my position of power to embarrass her.
lines.zh: 我利用这个有利位置来让她难堪。

lines.en: : If you’re waiting for a punchline, there isn’t one.
lines.zh: : 如果你在等一句俏皮话，那没有。

lines.en: : You...You’re just carrying around my panties?
lines.zh: : 你……你一直随身带着我的内裤？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : The...panties that I was wearing? The ones that I took off because they got soaked from the rain?
lines.zh: : 那条……我穿过的内裤？因为被雨淋湿所以脱下来的那条？

lines.en: : Is there something about that you’re not understanding?
lines.zh: : 这里面有什么你没搞懂的地方吗？

lines.en: : Yes. The part where you took them. And the part where you stuffed them into your pocket. And the part where you are now confessing your evils to me instead of just keeping them and preventing this talk.
lines.zh: : 有。你拿走它们的部分。你把它们塞进口袋的部分。还有你现在跑来向我坦白罪行、而不是干脆留着它们好省掉这场对话的部分。

lines.en: : I just figured you’d want them back after randomly storming out.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你那天毫无征兆地冲出去了，应该会想要拿回来。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties2
: Me storming out has nothing to do with whether or not it’s okay to just walk around with my underwear like they’re some kind of badge of honor!
lines.zh: : 我冲不冲出去，跟你能不能就这么把我的内裤当什么荣誉勋章一样随身带着毫无关系！

lines.en: : You don’t see me walking around with your underwear, do you?
lines.zh: : 你也没见我拿着你的内裤到处走吧？

lines.en: : No. But I don’t wear underwear, so.
lines.zh: : 没有。可我不穿内裤，所以。

lines.en: : What? But you wear jeans like, every day. Doesn’t that make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 什么？可你几乎每天都穿牛仔裤啊。那样不难受吗？

lines.en: : I find that my pants are off enough for that not to be much of an issue.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的裤子脱下来的次数够多，所以这不太成问题。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties3
: Hah...You know, if I didn’t grow up with an older brother who saw my panties on the floor every time he came into my room, this would be a real shock for me right now.
lines.zh: : 哈……你知道吗，如果我不是从小有个每次进我房间都能看见我内裤扔在地上的哥哥，我现在肯定真的会被吓到。

lines.en: : I expected better from you, Sensei. Especially after our night of passion together should have gotten all of that pent up energy out of your system.
lines.zh: : 我本来对你期待更高的，Sensei。尤其是在我们一起度过了那个激情之夜、本该把你那些憋着的精力全发泄掉之后。

lines.en: : I can’t say that spending the majority of the night in there alone while waiting for the rain to stop was the happy ending I was looking for.
lines.zh: : 我可不能说，那一晚上大半时间都是我一个人在里面干等雨停，这就是我想要的大团圆结局。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties4
: Well, you’re smiling now, aren’t you? Which means that the ending had to be at least {i}kind of{/i} happy. Otherwise, you’d be all like, “Uta! I hate you and I’m keeping your panties!”
lines.zh: : 可是你现在在笑啊，不是吗？这说明结局至少{i}有点{/i}圆满。不然你就会是那种反应：“Uta！我恨你，你的内裤我不还了！”

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 还是什么的。

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : What? The conversation is over. Just toss the panties into the pile and we can move onto why I was thinking about you rather than what you did with my underwear.
lines.zh: : 什么？这话题到此为止。把内裤丢进那堆里，我们就可以进入正题了——我为什么在想你，而不是你拿我的内裤干了什么。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties1
: Wait, you didn’t actually do anything with my underwear, did you? Because that would be weird and gross and not entirely unexpected.
lines.zh: : 等等，你其实没拿我的内裤做什么吧？因为那会又奇怪又恶心，而且完全在意料之中。

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。

lines.en: : Are you lying to me, you panty-stealing coward?
lines.zh: : 你在骗我吗，你这个偷内裤的懦夫？

lines.en: : No more than you’re lying to me about why you left the hotel.
lines.zh: : 不比你骗我——骗我你为什么离开酒店——来得更多。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties5
: Hah...Sensei, it’s not really {i}lying{/i} if I just...don’t tell you certain things, is it?
lines.zh: : 哈……Sensei，如果我只是……有些事没告诉你，那也算不上{i}骗{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Not really. But I think there’s an argument to be made about whether or not certain scenarios arise in which that {i}would{/i} be lying, right?
lines.zh: : 严格说不算。不过我觉得可以论证一下：会不会存在某些情形，那样做也算{i}骗人{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : If I were to get a mysterious text and storm out of the room right now, you’d definitely think I was hiding something, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 要是我现在收到一条神秘短信然后冲出房间，你肯定会觉得我在瞒着什么，对吧？

lines.en: : So, what? You want to know who sent me that message? Will that make you drop this?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你想知道是谁给我发了那条消息？知道这个你就能放过这件事了吗？

lines.en: : It would be a start.
lines.zh: : 至少是个开始。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties6
: Well, sucks for you because I don’t even know.
lines.zh: : 那你倒霉了，因为我自己都不知道。

lines.en: : I don’t believe that.
lines.zh: : 我不信。

lines.en: : Believe whatever you want. If it was something I thought you should know, I wouldn’t have just left without saying anything.
lines.zh: : 你爱信不信。如果那是我认为你该知道的事，我就不会一声不吭地走掉了。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say the other day that you want me to know more about you, though?
lines.zh: : 可你前几天不是刚说过，你想让我多了解你一点吗？

lines.en: : Do you remember what I said after that?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我那之后说了什么吗？

lines.en: : No. I tend to pick out the best parts of conversations and just hang onto those instead of letting whatever negative connotations they ride in on weigh them down.
lines.zh: : 不记得。我习惯挑对话里最好的部分死死攥住，而不是让随之而来的那些负面含义把它压垮。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} remember, because both parts of what I said are still true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}我{/i}记得，因为我说的两半都还成立。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} want you to know more about me. I just don’t want you to know anything that might make you look at me differently.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}想让你多了解我。我只是不想让你知道任何可能改变你看我的眼光的事。

lines.en: : Is that not the purpose of learning more about someone? Changing the way you look at them?
lines.zh: : 可了解一个人不就是为了改变你看他的方式吗？

lines.en: : Not when I already like the way we look at each other.
lines.zh: : 当我已经喜欢我们现在看彼此的方式时，就不是了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties7
: So anyway! That was embarrassing! But I’m glad we’ve finally moved on!
lines.zh: : 那么总之！刚才那段挺丢人的！不过我很高兴我们终于翻篇了！

lines.en: : Have we?
lines.zh: : 翻篇了吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties8
: You know, I like you a lot better when you’re not trying to pry into my personal life.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你不打探我私生活的时候，我更喜欢你。

lines.en: : I just want to know more about you. Whether or not that changes the way I look at you is up to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多了解你。那会不会改变我看你的方式，取决于我自己。

lines.en: : Even if it does, though, wouldn’t that just mean I’m {i}not{/i} someone you want to get closer to anyway? Wouldn’t your interest be better spent on someone who will, you know, {i}understand{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 可就算会，那不也正说明我{i}不是{/i}你想要靠近的人吗？你的兴趣放在某个能……{i}理解{/i}你的人身上不是更好吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties9
: No.
: Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不？

lines.en: : Because it’s better for everyone if you never understand me.
lines.zh: : 因为对所有人来说，你永远都别理解我才好。

lines.en: : It’s better if I’m Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 我当 Uta 酱就好。

lines.en: : Uta-chan is the perfect girl who always makes the right decisions. Who cares about everyone else first and herself last.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱是完美的女孩，永远做出正确的决定。永远把别人放在第一位，自己放在最后。

lines.en: : She never makes mistakes or does things she looks back on with regret.
lines.zh: : 她从不犯错，也从不回头看自己做过的事而后悔。

lines.en: : And that’s all Uta Ushibori ever does.
lines.zh: : 而 Uta Ushibori 所做的一切，就只有后悔。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties10
: W...Why do you want to get to know me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为……为什么你想了解我，Sensei？

lines.en: : Why did you ask me to stop being Uta-chan when we were in that hotel?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们在那家酒店的时候，你让我别再当 Uta 酱了？

lines.en: : What can Uta Ushibori do for you that she can’t? You love Uta-chan, right? You’ve asked her...err, {i}me{/i} to marry you like a billion times already.
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori 有什么是她做不到、而你又能从她身上得到的？你爱的是 Uta 酱吧？你都已经向她……呃，向{i}我{/i}求过十亿次婚了。

lines.en: : I’m...fine with just always being that if you want! I don’t have to swap back and forth if the change gets annoying or exhausting.
lines.zh: : 如果……如果你想的话，我一直那样也没问题！如果这个切换让你觉得烦或者累，我不一定要来回换。

lines.en: : It’s not like...It’s not like that’s not still part of who I am, you know? It’s all the best parts! I learned to separate them so that...so that we can all move forward and...
lines.zh: : 又不是……又不是说那就不算我的一部分了，你知道吗？那全都是最好的部分！我学会了把它们分开，好让……好让我们都能继续往前走，而且……

lines.en: scene utadormpanties11
: And not get caught in the thorns of decisions Uta Ushibori made.
lines.zh: : 而且不会被 Uta Ushibori 所做过的那些决定的荆棘缠住。

lines.en: : Our pasts aren’t what define us, you know.
lines.zh: : 我们的过去并不能定义我们，你知道吗。

lines.en: : They might help shape us into who we become, but it ultimately rests on us to figure that out ourselves.
lines.zh: : 它们也许会把我们塑造成后来的样子，但最终要靠我们自己想明白。

lines.en: : If there are things you did in the past that turned you into the person you are today, even if those things are ten times uglier by comparison, I still want to know about them because they made {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你过去做过一些事，造就了今天的你，哪怕那些事相比之下丑陋十倍，我仍然想知道，因为是它们造就了{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Uta-chan is great because she’s perfect. But Uta Ushibori is great because she’s so heavily flawed.
lines.zh: : Uta 酱之所以美好，是因为她完美。但 Uta Ushibori 之所以美好，是因为她满身瑕疵。

lines.en: : Uta Ushibori is great because she’s an actual human being who makes mistakes and {i}suffers{/i} for those mistakes.
lines.zh: : Uta Ushibori 之所以美好，是因为她是个真正的人——会犯错，并且为那些错{i}受苦{/i}。

lines.en: : And Uta-chan knows no suffering at all.
lines.zh: : 而 Uta 酱根本不懂什么叫受苦。

lines.en: : Are you telling me you want me to suffer?
lines.zh: : 你是在告诉我，你想让我受苦？

lines.en: : It might sound mean, but yeah. I am.
lines.zh: : 听着也许很刻薄，但没错。我是这么想的。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties12
: Of course you’d be a sadist. Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 你果然是个虐待狂。我怎么会不觉得意外呢？

lines.en: : If you’re going to flirt instead of {i}talk,{/i} at least do so in a way that-
lines.zh: : 如果你打算调情而不是{i}谈正事{/i}，至少也该用一种——

lines.en: scene utadormpanties13
: I’ll talk. I just...
lines.zh: : 我会谈的。我只是……

lines.en: : You’ll be the first person other than Io or my family who’s ever heard any of this.
lines.zh: : 除了 Io 和我家人之外，你是第一个听到这些的人。

lines.en: : It’ll be with less, uhh...{i}specifics,{/i} though...because I still {i}am{/i} worried that you’ll figure me out one day and not want anything to do with me anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过会少一些，呃……{i}细节{/i}……因为我还是{i}确实{/i}担心有一天你会看清我，然后就再也不想跟我有任何关系了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties14
: That would be a huge blow financially. And I don’t know if I’d ever be able to recover from losing my number one customer.
lines.zh: : 那在经济上会是巨大的打击。而且我不知道失去头号顾客之后我还能不能缓过来。

lines.en: : I think Uta-chan is slipping out again.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Uta 酱又要溜出来了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties13
: Right. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。是啊。

lines.en: : It’s hard to tell the difference sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候真的分不清。

lines.en: : Uhh...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 呃……让我想想……

lines.en: : Okay, I guess the easiest way of putting it would be...
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想最简单的说法是……

lines.en: : I’ve, uhh...
: I’ve done some...{i}stuff...{/i}that I’m not very proud of in the past...
lines.zh: : 我以前做过一些……{i}事{/i}……我并不怎么自豪的事……

lines.en: : Impulsive stuff. Like...when I pulled you into the tea ceremony room the other day but, like...worse than that.
lines.zh: : 冲动的事。就像……那天我把你拉进茶室那样，但，比如……比那更糟。

lines.en: : A lot worse.
lines.zh: : 糟得多。

lines.en: : Stuff that seemed like a really great idea at the time...
lines.zh: : 那些在当时看起来真是个绝妙主意的事……

lines.en: : But...when you’re a little kid, it’s...uhh...it’s easier to not really understand the possible, uhh...consequences for your actions...
lines.zh: : 可是……当你还是个小孩子的时候，就……呃……就更容易搞不懂自己的行为可能带来什么，呃……后果……

lines.en: : And so some of those great ideas wind up coming back to bite you.
lines.zh: : 于是那些绝妙的主意里，有一些最后会回过头来咬你一口。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties15
: I, uhh...I guess I haven’t ever told you the real reason I moved here, have I?
lines.zh: : 我，呃……我想我从来没告诉过你我搬来这儿的真正原因，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve told me about your dead grandpa a hundred times. I’m not sure if that’s the full story, though.
lines.zh: : 你那死去的爷爷你已经跟我讲过一百遍了。不过我不确定那是不是全部。

lines.en: : That was part of it. But, uhh...the bigger part is that I was dealing with this, uhh...{i}issue{/i} back at home.
lines.zh: : 那是其中一部分。可是，呃……更大的一部分是，我在老家的时候在处理这个，呃……{i}麻烦{/i}。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties16
: That stuff about bad decisions and...consequences we don’t really think of when we’re that young...
lines.zh: : 就是那个关于错误的决定、以及我们那么小的时候根本不会去想的后果……

lines.en: : Well, that...uhh...that put me into a pretty...unsafe position...
lines.zh: : 那……呃……那把我置于了一个相当……不安全的处境……

lines.en: : I kinda...may have had a bit of a...stalker problem...
lines.zh: : 我大概……可能遇到过一点……跟踪狂问题……

lines.en: : How...big of a problem, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体……多大的问题？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: It was...pretty bad...
lines.zh: : 挺……严重的……

lines.en: scene utadormpanties17
: N...Nothing ever happened to me, though! He never laid a hand on me! I’m still a...a certified virgin and...it was really just the {i}prospect{/i} of something bad happening that landed me here!
lines.zh: : 不……不过什么都没发生在我身上！他从来没碰过我！我现在还是个……经过认证的处女，而且……真的只是{i}有可能{/i}发生坏事这一点，就让我落到了这儿！

lines.en: : You didn’t have to-
lines.zh: : 你不用——

lines.en: : I wanted you to know that part! That I’m not...completely tainted yet! That I’m clean! I swear!
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道这一点！我还没有……完全被玷污！我是干净的！我发誓！

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : It was just a series of bad decisions that I am still paying for in ways I never expected! Which is why I left the other day! Because I am {i}still{/i} paying for those things and...
lines.zh: : 那只是一连串错误的决定，而我至今还在以我从没想过的方式为它们付出代价！这就是为什么我那天会走掉！因为我{i}至今还在{/i}为那些事付出代价，而且……

lines.en: scene utadormpanties18
: Hahah...I said that I wouldn’t give you any specifics but, here I am, about to give you {i}all{/i} the specifics because I don’t want to cause any misunderstandings and...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……我说过不会告诉你任何细节的，可现在我却要把{i}全部{/i}细节都告诉你，因为我不想造成任何误会，而且……

lines.en: : You know, this story is a lot harder to tell to someone who isn’t family. I didn’t have to worry about any of {i}them{/i} leaving me because of stupid stuff I did.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，这个故事对非亲非故的人讲起来难多了。对{i}他们{/i}我不用担心会因为自己做过的蠢事而离开我。

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about me leaving you, either. Not over something like this.
lines.zh: : 你也不用担心我会离开你。至少不会因为这种事。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties17
: But you don’t even know the half of it yet, Sensei. This isn’t something that’s going to go away. We’ve {i}tried{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 可你现在连一半都还不知道呢，Sensei。这不是会消失的东西。我们{i}试过{/i}了。

lines.en: : The whole reason my brother is in jail is because he beat the guy who was stalking me until he couldn’t even move anymore. But the problem wasn’t {i}just{/i} him.
lines.zh: : 我哥之所以会进监狱，就是因为他把跟踪我的那个人打到再也动不了。可问题{i}不只{/i}在他身上。

lines.en: : The problem is {i}everywhere.{/i} The problem is {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 问题{i}无处不在{/i}。问题就是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} am everywhere.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}无处不在。

lines.en: : Do you understand what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 你明白我在说什么吗？

lines.en: : Understand that this is something we should probably shelve for right now. You’ve told me enough and I get that it’s overwhelming for you.
lines.zh: : 明白这件事我们大概该先搁一搁了。你已经说得够多了，我理解这对你来说很难承受。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties19
: Do you get it now? Why I have to be someone else?
lines.zh: : 你现在明白了吗？为什么我必须变成另一个人？

lines.en: : I changed everything...Completely reinvented Uta...
lines.zh: : 我把一切都改了……彻底重新发明了 Uta……

lines.en: : But I still can’t shed the parts of me that made me have to change in the first place.
lines.zh: : 可我还是甩不掉那些最初逼得我必须改变的部分。

lines.en: : The real me keeps wanting to bleed through...keeps wanting to do more things I {i}know{/i} are mistakes...but that doesn’t change a thing.
lines.zh: : 真实的我总想渗出来……总想去做更多我{i}明知{/i}是错误的事……可那什么都改变不了。

lines.en: : This is just who I am.
lines.zh: : 我就是这样的。

lines.en: : One big mistake.
lines.zh: : 一个大错。

lines.en: : And nothing will ever change that.
lines.zh: : 而什么都改变不了这一点。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties20
: Which is why I didn’t want you to know.
lines.zh: : 所以我不想让你知道。

lines.en: : I wanted this to keep going without you ever realizing there’s another side to all of this.
lines.zh: : 我想让这一切就这么继续下去，永远不被你发现它还有另一面。

lines.en: : But I’m not allowed to want anything.
lines.zh: : 可我是不被允许想要任何东西的。

lines.en: : I haven’t suffered enough yet.
lines.zh: : 我受的苦还不够。

lines.en: : Well, as someone who claimed just moments ago that I {i}want{/i} you to suffer, I beg to differ.
lines.zh: : 嗯，作为一个几分钟前刚宣称我{i}想{/i}让你受苦的人，我不敢苟同。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties21
: It seems to me that you’ve suffered more than enough. And I don’t know if the source of that will ever go away, but I’m sure it will probably become easier to deal with over time.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，你受的苦早已够多了。我不知道它的源头会不会消失，但我敢肯定，随着时间推移，它大概会变得更容易应对。

lines.en: : I don’t think it will.
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为。

lines.en: : Then don’t think at all.
lines.zh: : 那就什么都别想。

lines.en: : Not thinking at all just makes it harder to deal with when it comes back to bite me again. Which it always does.
lines.zh: : 什么都不想，只会让它再回来咬我的时候更难应付。而它总是会回来。

lines.en: : {i}I was just a kid, Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我当时只是个孩子，Sensei。{/i}

lines.en: : I had no idea what I was doing. I {i}still{/i} have no idea what I’m doing and I’m in high school now.
lines.zh: : 我当时根本不知道自己在做什么。我现在都上高中了，{i}依然{/i}不知道自己在做什么。

lines.en: : Something you did that long ago would never change the way I look at you today.
lines.zh: : 你那么在久以前做过的事，永远都不会改变我今天看你的方式。

lines.en: : And while I won’t say I’m thankful it happened as it’s clearly made your life very hard to manage, I will reiterate once more that I like both forms of Uta Ushibori.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不会说我很庆幸它发生过——它显然让你的生活变得非常难熬——但我愿意再重申一次：Uta Ushibori 的两种样子，我都喜欢。

lines.en: : And that my opinion of you hasn’t lessened in the slightest.
lines.zh: : 而我对你的评价，丝毫没有降低。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties22
: Hah...
: Sharing your feelings is exhausting. I have no idea how Io does it literally all day every day.
lines.zh: : 把自己的感受说出来真累。我真不知道 Io 是怎么做到一天到晚、每天如此的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m sure there’s a lot I don’t know about her either.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过我敢肯定她身上也有很多我不知道的事。

lines.en: : Course there is.
lines.zh: : 那当然。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties23
: Girls like us aren’t exactly open books. And even when you get us open, it’s like everything’s in a completely different language.
lines.zh: : 像我们这样的女孩可不是什么打开的书。而且就算你把我们打开了，里面的东西也像是完全用另一种语言写成的。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for dumping that on you, Sensei. I tried to spare you, but you just kept on pushing and I ain’t good at dealing with stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉把这些都倒给你了，Sensei。我本来想放过你的，可你一直追问，而我不太擅长应付这种事。

lines.en: : It does feel a little better to...clue you in on the different sides of me, though. I was really worried that you’d see that as a big ole red flag and just book it once I started talking.
lines.zh: : 不过能让你知道我的不同面，确实感觉好一点了。我真的很担心你会把这当成一个巨大的危险信号，然后我一开口你就掉头就跑。

lines.en: : Nah. You let me borrow your underwear for over 24 hours, so the least I could do was hear you out until the end.
lines.zh: : 不会。你都把内裤借给我超过 24 小时了，我至少也得听你把话说完吧。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties24
: Thanks. But please download CashApp and shoot me some money next time you decide to do that. I’m letting you off the hook for last time as a free trial, but I’m charging hourly from now on.
lines.zh: : 谢了。不过下次你再打算那么做，请下载个 CashApp 给我打点钱。上次我算你免费试用不追究，但从现在起我要按小时收费。

lines.en: : Noriko lets me borrow her underwear for free and hers are a lot fancier than yours.
lines.zh: : Noriko 免费借我内裤，而且她的比你的高级多了。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties25
: That offended me a lot more than I thought it would. A girl takes great pride in her panties, you know.
lines.zh: : 这话比我想象的更伤我。一个女孩对自己的内裤可是相当自豪的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : Not enough pride to keep them on in a hotel, apparently.
lines.zh: : 显然还没自豪到能在酒店里穿着不脱。

lines.en: : They were wet and I was uncomfortable. I regret nothing other than the fact that they wound up in your hands.
lines.zh: : 它们湿了，我不舒服。除了它们最后落到你手里这件事，我什么都不后悔。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll be more than happy to {i}make you comfortable{/i} in my own way next time.
lines.zh: : 那下次我会非常乐意为{i}让你舒服{/i}而用我自己的方式来。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties26
: Saying that right after I open up about my history of impulsive and bad decisions? Have you no shame, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我刚敞开心扉讲完自己冲动和错误决定的历史，你就说这个？你到底有没有廉耻啊，Sensei？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties27
: And now your {i}phone{/i} is going off?! You should know darn well you’re supposed to silence your phone during heart-to-hearts with a cute girl! You really {i}do{/i} have no shame!
lines.zh: : 而且现在你的{i}手机{/i}又响了？！你该很清楚，跟可爱女孩谈心的时候是必须把手机调静音的！你还{i}真是{/i}一点廉耻都没有！

lines.en: : It’s probably just Ami asking when I’ll be home for dinner.
lines.zh: : 大概只是 Ami 问我什么时候回家吃晚饭。

lines.en: : Damn that top contender and her unflappable uncle love! We’re supposed to be having a moment here!
lines.zh: : 该死的头号竞争者和她那坚不可摧的叔叔之恋！我们本来正在培养感情呢！

lines.en: scene black
I tap on my recent messages, expecting Ami’s name to show up at the top of the queue.
lines.zh: 我点开最近的消息，以为队列最上方会出现 Ami 的名字。

lines.en: But what I find is something completely unexpected.
lines.zh: 可我看到的却完全出乎意料。

lines.en: if uta_custom_name != "":
{i}You have 1 new message from [uta_custom_name]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}您有 1 条来自 [uta_custom_name] 的新消息！{/i}

lines.en: else:
{i}You have 1 new message from Uta Ushibori!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}您有 1 条来自 Uta Ushibori 的新消息！{/i}

lines.en: scene utalolinude
: Sensei? Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : Sensei？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties28
: Is it Ami like you expected? Or is it Noriko asking when you’re going to return her fancy underwear?
lines.zh: : 是你猜的 Ami 吗？还是 Noriko 问你什么时候还她的高级内裤？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : It’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties29
: Oh?
: Don’t tell me it’s Princess Maya summoning you for a late night booty call?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我是 Maya 公主召你去深夜幽会？

lines.en: scene utadormpanties30
: Let me see your phone. I know how to deal with-
lines.zh: : 让我看看你的手机。我知道该怎么处理——

lines.en: : Don’t.
scene utadormpanties31
: Huh?
: Don’t touch my phone.
lines.zh: : 别碰我的手机。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...sure.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……好吧。

lines.en: : I wasn’t trying to get up in your bubble or anything.
lines.zh: : 我不是想侵犯你的私人空间什么的。

lines.en: scene utadormpanties32
: I have to go.
lines.zh: : 我得走了。

lines.en: : What?...
: This isn’t just payback for how I left you hanging the other night, is it? Do you really have to go? Or are you just saying that?
lines.zh: : 这不只是为了报复我那天晚上把你晾在那儿吧？你真的非走不可吗？还是你只是说说而已？

lines.en: scene black
: I really have to go. But I’ll see you in school.
lines.zh: : 我真的得走了。不过学校见。

lines.en: : Really? You can’t even stay just...a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你就不能再……多待一会儿吗？

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : I don’t want to make a mistake.
lines.zh: : 我不想犯错。

lines.en: I leave Uta’s room.
lines.zh: 我离开了 Uta 的房间。

lines.en: The walk home does not cling to my memory.
lines.zh: 回家的路并没有留在我的记忆里。

lines.en: But the glow of a dim blue light does as I indulge in the rotten fruit of her past impulses.
lines.zh: 但那抹幽暗的蓝光留下了——当我沉溺于她过去那些冲动结出的腐烂果实时。

lines.en: $ uta_love += 1
$ utadorm30 = True
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
